notes.title: SPOT BUILDER : CREATE YOUR OWN MAPS
notes.content: [h2]Welcome to the Paid Early Access![/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Going Paid: A New Chapter[/h3][p][/p][p]Since its launch, [b]Tricking 0[/b] has been available for free in Early Access as I worked on it as a solo developer in my free time. For the past year, I've been working on the game full-time, which has allowed for significant progress and a ton of new content.[/p][p]This [b]transition to a paid Early Access[/b] at a price of [b]$15[/b] is the next step in the game's evolution. It will allow me to build a sustainable studio, potentially hire a small team, and continue development to finish the game. The price of the base game (the sandbox) should gradually increase towards $25-$30 for the full release as new features and content are added.[/p][p][b]Existing players who got the game for free will keep their copies and will not be charged[/b]. In the future, I plan to release [b]cosmetic and career DLCs[/b]. This will give players who have enjoyed the free version a way to financially support the game's development without taking anything away from them.[/p][p]For new players, a [b]free demo[/b] is now available. This demo is [b]time-limited to 8 hours of playtime[/b], giving you plenty of time to test the game and ensure it runs well on your hardware before you decide to purchase.[/p][p]Thank you for all your support during the open testing phase.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes: The Arena Becomes Yours[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Spot Builder: Create Your Own Map[/h3][p][/p][p]I'm excited to finally bring this highly requested feature to life. You can now turn the Arena map into your own personal training ground. The community has already created plenty of amazing maps you can find and share on our Discord.[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Arena Map[/b] is now fully customizable.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Spot Builder[/b] menu lets you move, rotate, scale, duplicate, and delete elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Spawn new elements from other maps and use them in your custom arena.[/p][/*][*][p]Save and load your maps as local JSON files.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Share your maps:[/b] You can send your JSON map files to friends so they can load them in their game.[/p][/*][*][p]An [b]Undo/Redo[/b] system has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Static Batching[/b] optimization has been implemented to combine meshes, reduce draw calls, and improve GPU performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Spot Builder Elements:[/p][p][/p][p]The Spot Builder includes a wide range of elements from across the game's maps, allowing for endless creativity. You can use various [b]parkour modules, trampolines, slides, and mats[/b], as well as natural elements like [b]rocks, trees, and other vegetation[/b]. There are also new objects like [b]wooden stairs, metal bridges, and concrete slabs[/b] to build with.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]New Tricks & Animations[/h2][p][/p][p]This update brings a massive overhaul to the trick system and adds a ton of new moves.[/p][list][*][p]The [b]right-side twisting bug[/b] has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Raiz-type moves[/b] have been moved to the forward flips, allowing right-side flips to be a mirror of the left-side flips.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now perform side flips and aerials on your right side.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]Mega landing stance[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Complete and Semi[/b] landing is now the default landing type ([b]Punch[/b], [b]Hyper[/b], and [b]Mega[/b] are inputted as variations).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kicks inputs[/b] have been reworked to be more consistent with the flips (e.g., Cheat 10 is the same rotation as Cheat 9 but with a hyper hook).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]New & Reworked Tricks:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Cork mega[/p][/*][*][p]Front half, front half complete, front half hyper[/p][/*][*][p]Full complete, full punch, full dleg, full round, full hyper, full hyperhook, full mega, full semi[/p][/*][*][p]Front full, front full semi, front full mega[/p][/*][*][p]Gainer half / Gainer Arabian, gainer semi, gainer mega, Moonkick turbo[/p][/*][*][p]Gainer dragonfly semi[/p][/*][*][p]Side flip (left and right), side flip twist (right), step-in side flip twist (right)[/p][/*][*][p]Backflip, Backflip swing, Gainer flash, Gainer punch, Gainer switch[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Freefall & Physics Updates[/h2][p][/p][p]The ragdoll and physics have been heavily revised to make the character feel more alive and realistic.[/p][list][*][p]The [b]CatTwist[/b] feature has been added to the Freefall mode. Hold D-pad left or right while in Freefall to trigger procedural twisting.[/p][/*][*][p]A new [b]shoulder articulation[/b] has been added to the ragdoll, making the character feel less stiff.[/p][/*][*][p]Hand shapes now automatically change based on the character's body position.[/p][/*][*][p]The character now looks at the ground 0.5 seconds before landing, regardless of the spin amount.[/p][/*][*][p]The right arm issue (doing "weird things over the head") has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Trampoline Improvements[/h2][p][/p][p]The trampoline physics and appearance have been completely redone.[/p][list][*][p]Physics have been reworked for a more realistic feel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Springs[/b] have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Springs now update correctly when the trampoline is rescaled.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotation issues have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Drag has been rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]A new metal frame has been created that scales while keeping a consistent diameter.[/p][/*][*][p]Pads have been added around the trampoline.[/p][/*][*][p]The trampoline now only affects limbs passing through the frame in a downward direction.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Visuals & Optimization[/h2][p][/p][p]The game's visuals have been enhanced and performance has been improved.[/p][list][*][p][b]NEW Grass Shader:[/b] The old grass shader has been replaced with a brand-new one created from scratch.[/p][/*][*][p]The Unity engine has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mac version has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]All [b]quality settings[/b] have been exposed in the Settings menu, allowing you to create and save custom settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Occlusion culling[/b] has been disabled in the Arena map to fix issues with things being unnecessarily culled.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes & Other Changes[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]A fix was implemented to remove duplicate elements from saved maps on load.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorials[/b] have been reworked and fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]rocks colliders[/b] now better match the visible geometry.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer is now disabled by default for those with issues of controllers spawning two characters. You can now set the maximum amount of local players in the settings.[/p][/*][/list]

It’s a huge update because I changed the way we play the game for kicks and variations. There is not need to hold any button during the transitions now, so the games flows much better.

If you found the game hard I encourage you to give it another shot. And I also recommend for everyone to redo at least the Variations Tutorial to understand how it’s done now. 

I hope that you will enjoy this update, can’t wait to get your feedback 😊

notes.title: Hot Fix - Parkour System Rework
notes.content:
This update includes a few global game quality improvements and fixes, especially a rework of the climb up animations integration, here are the changes in detail :

[list]
[*] Fixed a camera issue when running forward, that was very unpleasant, and it looked that the character was not running at a constant speed
[*] Tweaked the running animations so that the shoulders are lower, the guy looked so stiff before
[*] Fixed / reworked the transition from ragdoll in the water to swimming
[*] Reworked the climb up parkour system, so it should feel much better now and more accurate
[*] Fixed a glitch when climbing up low, (jumping on a small ledge while running), that sometimes triggered the high fall and the roll when landing on the ledge
[*] Fixed the flipping onto things glitch, so now you should just radgoll in and fall if you land and your trick is not over
[*] Tweaked a bit the Arena map
[*] Fixed the xray broken bone not resetting on going to marker
[/list]

Enjoy !

notes.title: Alpha 3.7 Update
notes.content:
This update will allow you to train your cliff-jumping skills and discover a new air drag mechanic while jumping off a hot air balloon in Polynesia, it also includes a lot of fixes to increase smoothness

It includes the following things :
- Disabling of self body collisions to improve ragdoll stability and physics accuracy
- Fix on Camera tracking glitch
- Improvement on Camera reset when player position isn't continuous, spawn, teleportation, replay
- New air drag realistic implementation for skydiving
- New air drag non realistic implementation to practice cliff jumping while keeping fall speed in a range that's manageable for the engine
- New map : Air Balloon
- New trick : Triple Full landing complete to swing out of it
- Fix on a glitch that launched the character in the air when automatically transition to ragdoll after over-rotating a trick
- Improved shore waves on Playa Escondida

notes.title: Free Running Update
notes.content:
The Free Running update is live on Steam. It’s a huge step for the game and I’m so happy to share the intense work I did for the last few months!!

Apart from the jump height variations, the vertical locomotion and the possibility to run into some flips, I had rework some big parts of the game.

The biggest one being the Replay System :

I developed a brand new replay system that will always replay your actions as you did them, the ragdoll will always fall the same way. You can set the loop brackets and adjust the speed with the triggers or the mouse (first bracket is by default set to your last Set or Teleportation to the marker). You can also hide the UI to record pure beauty, using the left joystick click. You can zoom in and out using the left joystick or the W and S keys). I let you have fun with it !!

I also introduced a Session Marker :

Marker inspired by skate, you can set it using the arrow down of your controller or the M key on your keyboard, and teleport to your marker to retry your line using the arrow up on your keyboard or the G key on your keyboard.

I added a Multidirectional Rolling System :

Depending on your height and speed direction you will roll in a specific way.

Enjoy 😉


[h2]PATCH NOTE [/h2]

- Flip from height

- High and low tricks depending on the speed of your right joystick input

- Locomotion rework, high fall, low fall, low jump, medium climb and high climb

- New replay system
